Name: Joja's Hauntings
Author: MindMeltMax
TagLine: Strange things happen around this store this close to spirits eve
Description:
**Happy Halloween!**
This is my favorite time of the year so I just had to put something out to fit the theme.
Enjoy this time of the year, you might not be here for it next year....

**Compatible with 1.5**

**Requirements :**
- [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400)

**Details :**
This mod is centered around a scavenger hunt in joja mart, find all the items and beat the final objective to win a modest prize.
_Note_ : Everything happens inside the store and only happens a day before spirits eve, if you don't do it then, you have to wait till next year.

**Installation Details :**
- Download
- Unzip in games mods folder
- Launch game
